adjudicated_statement: Over C with Q-coefficients, at (g,n)=(6,6). Let Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2] be the smooth Deligne-Mumford stack of pure dimension 15 of balanced genus-six degree-four covers (FND-0162). Let S range over reduced separated finite-type C-schemes carrying a (CE)+(N)+(BAL) family in the sense of FND-0167, including connected components of reduced separated finite-type etale scheme atlases of Hbar^bal. The constant-coefficient corner Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) is not an invariant of the stack Hbar^bal: it depends on S. Explicitly, the mu_3-Kummer cover C->M_{0,4} cut out by y^3=x(x-1), with smooth projective model Cbar of genus one, yields a nonempty irreducible finite-etale cover Mtilde of M_{0,18} whose Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Mtilde;Q) contains a nonzero Hodge type (15,1), obtained as the compact-support Kunneth summand Q(-1) tensor H^{1,0}(Cbar)^{tensor 14} and surviving removal of the pairwise-diagonal locus of dimension at most 14 because Hodge numbers of compactly supported cohomology vanish in filtration degree strictly larger than dimension (Deligne, Theorie de Hodge III, Theorem 8.2.4(ii)). By the Bujokas-Patel theorem that the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle F of a general cover in the classical simply-branched Hurwitz space H_{d,g} is balanced whenever g>=(d-3)(d-1) (hence for (d,g)=(4,6)), together with FND-0159 (the classical Hurwitz space is etale over the configuration space of r=2g+2d-2=18 points), there is a connected finite-etale Hurwitz chart X over M_{0,18} whose balanced open is nonempty. Finite-etale pullback/trace of the type-(15,1) class along a connected component Xtilde of X times_{M_{0,18}} Mtilde, followed by compact-support localization onto the balanced open V of Xtilde (FND-0165), produces a connected smooth 15-fold V, etale over Hbar^bal, with Gr^{15,1} Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(V;C) nonzero. Thus Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(V;Q) is not a finite direct sum of Q(-8). For any allowed atlas U, the disjoint union U sqcup V is again an allowed atlas and compactly supported cohomology is additive, so the same non-Tate summand appears in Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U sqcup V;Q). Consequently the j=8 instance of hypothesis (H-S) of FND-0167, namely that Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(S;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(-8), is false for some allowed S. FND-0167 itself does not assert (H-S). Any campaign statement that asserts or requires (H-S) while universally quantifying over a reduced locally Noetherian scheme atlas of Hbar^bal, or over all reduced separated finite-type C-schemes carrying the balanced setup, is therefore false as stated rather than merely unproved. (H-S) may be asserted only for a specifically named atlas, or replaced by a stack-level statement, which requires a compact-support mixed-Hodge formalism for Deligne-Mumford stacks that FND-0165 explicitly withholds. This does not address Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(Z;Q) for Z=Ord(U): the FND-0167 corner map injects Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(U) into a sum of Tate twists of corners of S, so it cannot transport non-Tateness from S to Z, and the discriminant in the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle has dimension 16 so F^{15} H_c^{16} need not vanish there.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads: ATT-0118 sections 1-4 and claims CLM-0118-1 through CLM-0118-5; REV-0165 confirmation of all five claims, dependency checks, and strongest_attack. The contested construction is the mu_3-Kummer cover y^3=x(x-1) of M_{0,4}, the Kunneth class of type (15,1) in Gr^W_16 H_c^16 of its 15-fold power over M_{0,18}, and finite-etale transport to a balanced simply-branched Hurwitz chart. Independently recomputed: Riemann-Hurwitz 2g(Cbar)-2=3(-2)+6=0 gives genus one; H_c^0(C)=0 forces compact-support Kunneth in degree 16 on C^15 to be exactly one H_c^2=Q(-1) and fourteen H_c^1, so the top-weight summand is Q(-1) tensor H^1(Cbar)^{tensor 14} of weight 16 and Hodge type (15,1); pairwise diagonals have dimension at most 14. Deligne, Theorie de Hodge III, Theorem 8.2.4(ii) (Publ. Math. IHES 44 (1974), pp. 38-39, doi 10.1007/BF02685881) states that Hodge numbers of H^n(X) vanish unless (p,q) lies in [n-N,N] x [n-N,N] when dim X=N, hence F^{15} H_c^{16} vanishes in dimension at most 14; morphisms of mixed Hodge structures are strict for W (Hodge II, and FND-0165), so the class survives both localizations. Finite-etale transfer over Q is injective on the corner. Existence of a nonempty simply-branched balanced open does not rest on CLM-0112-4 nor on the packet's composed elliptic witness FND-0154, which FND-0158 proves is never simply branched. Load-bearing existence is the Bujokas-Patel Main Theorem (arXiv:1504.03756v1): if g>=(d-3)(d-1) then the Casnati-Ekedahl bundle F of a general cover in the classical simply-branched Hurwitz space H_{d,g} is balanced; for (d,g)=(4,6) one has 6>=3, and a balanced rank-2 degree-9 bundle is O(4)+O(5). Combined with FND-0159 (classical Hurwitz space etale over the configuration space of r=18 points) and Clebsch irreducibility of H_{4,6}, a Zariski-open of simply-branched tetragonal covers is balanced, so a connected etale chart V of Hbar^bal with Gr^{15,1} Gr^W_16 H_c^{16}(V;C) nonzero exists. Adjoining V to any allowed atlas U yields U disjoint-union V, and H_c is additive. No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty; FND-0167 states (H-S) as a hypothesis and explicitly makes no assertion about its truth, so the present statement supplies new information rather than opposing FND-0167. Distinct from corroborated FND-0085 (finite branch maps do not imply mixed-Tate cohomology) and FND-0054 (a predicted Tate motive may not be used unconditionally): those leave Tate-ness open, whereas this exhibits an allowed base on which the j=8 corner is provably non-Tate. Compatible with CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, and RED-0001: the argument never touches Z, K, or M_{6,6}. REV-0165 already recorded that FND-0167's corner injections run from U into a sum of corners of S, so non-Tateness of S does not transport to Z=Ord(U); Delta has dimension 16, so the F^{15} vanishing used on the base does not apply to the discriminant. FND-0165 withholds compact-support mixed Hodge theory for Deligne-Mumford stacks, which is why the campaign's scheme-atlas quantification is the vulnerable one. Wording corrections relative to the candidate: (i) existence is attached to Bujokas-Patel rather than CLM-0112-4; (ii) (H-S) is FND-0167's hypothesis on any reduced separated finite-type C-scheme carrying the balanced setup, not merely on atlases; (iii) the Z-corner is excluded; (iv) FND-0167 itself is not described as asserting (H-S). Promote the narrowed statement; do not merge.
